what: R6 end-to-end scoring rule (docs/r6_plan_draft.md), sealed before any R6 model exists or is scored, and before any OASIS-3 head was run through navprep or any warp net.
setting: head-model commit 6ac8357: scripts/r6_e2e.py (on r5_e2e.py's scorer), run by scripts/train_r6_warp.sh after the R6 warp net. Two models, each through scripts/navprep.py --modality mr --cap-gb 7.5 exactly as the locator runs it: 'r5' = Dataset602 folds 0-4 + runs/r5/warp/final/last.pt (the live release 20261105-e519286's models); 'r6' = Dataset603 folds 0-4 + runs/r6/warp/final/last.pt. Arms as r5_e2e, all made from the case's charm input T1 (sim_series.py, seed = first 8 hex of sha1('r5-sim:' + case), Rician noise 0.02): 1mm, ax5, ax5gap, axsag5. Both models see the same input files. Cases are scored 3 at a time (--workers 3; each worker runs one navprep subprocess at a time), so navprep's wall time is measured under 3-way load: conservative for check (5); the GPU peak is per process and unaffected.
metrics: As r5_e2e / M1, against charm on the ORIGINAL 1 mm T1 of the case: the 10 MNI targets (unprojected); the rTMS EEG set (wp3_gate_rtms_set) and the 4 fiducials warped with our toMNI and projected on OUR skin vs charm's eeg_positions; per row the mean of case means and the worst single point; written-map min Jacobian; navprep wall time and GPU peak.
sets: In this order, each once: (1) pilot = the first 5 sorted R6 warp validation heads, both models, all arms: machinery only (training heads of both segmenters' folds; the chain stops before the test set if any run fails or any written map folds; numbers reported, never judged). (2) test = the OASIS-3 test heads of r6_oasis3_split whose charm run finished (data/manifests/r6.json; expected 100), both models, all arms: the one use of this test set. (3) compare = the 57 WP3 test cases, r6 on the 1mm arm only, against R5's rows on the same cases from runs/r5/e2e/compare/summary.json (R5 is not re-run there). r6_e2e.py refuses a test or compare case in either model's segmenter imagesTr or warp train_cases.
rule: R6 replaces R5 (adopt) only if ALL hold. On the test set's 1mm arm, r6 vs r5 on the same heads: (1) no folding (below); (2) the sum of r6's three gate-row means (targets, rTMS EEG set on our skin, fiducials on our skin) is lower than r5's; (3) no gate-row mean of r6 is worse than r5's by more than 0.05 mm; (4) no gate-row worst point of r6 is worse than r5's by more than 1.0 mm; (5) r6's navprep wall time <= 120 s per case on average (under 3-way load); (6) r6's GPU peak <= 7.5 GB. On the compare set (57, 1mm), r6 vs R5's rows: (7) no gate-row mean worse by more than 0.10 mm and no gate-row worst point worse by more than 1.0 mm. Why (7): the OASIS-3 test set is in-domain for R6 and unseen-scanner data for R5, so it favours R6; the 57 are unseen by both models and the closest to clinic scans; R5's adoption had no such guard and R5 would have failed it against the previous release. The 57 have been scored under earlier rules; here they only check one candidate for non-inferiority, nothing is chosen or tuned on them. Adopt: a new release (make_release.sh with the R6 models) is built and goes live only with the user's go; the result is reported either way. The WP3 gate (each gate row <= 2 mm mean and <= 5 mm worst point, no folding) is judged and reported per model and arm and does not change the adoption test. Reported, not gating: every arm; the test set per OASIS-3 stratum (normal: CDR 0; decline: CDR >= 0.5); paired per-case differences on the 1mm arm (mean, Wilcoxon signed-rank p); whole-cap EEG; cases passing all rows. Nothing is re-run on the test set after any code or setting change.
no_folding: written-map min Jacobian > 0 in both MNI2Conform_nonl and Conform2MNI_nonl on every test head of r6's 1mm arm (check (1)); counted and reported for every model and arm.
disclosure: Known before sealing: (1) R5 on the IXI test set and on the 57 (docs/r5_e2e_report.md): IXI 1mm targets 1.32 / 5.47, rTMS EEG 1.31 / 5.09, fiducials 1.52 / 10.94; the 57: targets 2.11 / 11.28, rTMS EEG 2.85 / 15.83, fiducials 3.37 / 15.63, 13/57 pass all; (2) where R5's worst compare-set points are (PIT28 TP10 21.9 mm; 1BC019 F1 19.1; 1BC004 PO10 16.5; 1BC017 Nz 15.6), all 16-60 mm from the image border; (3) OASIS-3 label-volume QC (runs/r6/oasis3_label_qc.tsv): no exclusion; (4) no OASIS-3 head has been run through navprep or any warp net or segmenter of ours; the smoke test uses 6 OASIS-3 TRAINING heads in a scratch directory.
